meteorologia.configuration.title: Meteorology Settings
meteorologia.configuration.naturalStorms: Supercells and tornadoes form on their own when it rains or thunders.
meteorologia.configuration.stormFrequenc: Multiplier for natural storm frequency (0 = never).
meteorologia.configuration.blockDamage.t: Tornadoes destroy blocks depending on their EF rating.
meteorologia.configuration.maxDebris.too: Maximum flying debris blocks per tornado. 0 disables debris.
meteorologia.configuration.vehicleDamage: Vehicles take damage from crashes and tornado debris.
meteorologia.configuration.rayMarching.t: Draw tornadoes and supercells with the ray marching shader.
meteorologia.configuration.stormSteps.to: Ray marching steps per pixel for storms. Lower is faster.
meteorologia.configuration.tornadoViewDi: How far (in blocks) tornadoes are drawn. Far ones are scaled up to stay visible.
meteorologia.configuration.stormFog.tool: Dense fog during heavy rain and near storms.
meteorologia.configuration.sunEnabled.to: Draw the realistic sun. The vanilla sun is hidden by this mod.
meteorologia.configuration.sunSize.toolt: Apparent diameter of the sun disc in degrees.
meteorologia.configuration.sunGlow.toolt: Strength of the halo around the sun.
meteorologia.configuration.cloudsEnabled: Draw the volumetric clouds. The vanilla clouds are hidden by this mod.
meteorologia.configuration.cloudAmount.t: Sky coverage: 0 = clear, 1 = overcast. Rain adds to it automatically.
0 = blocky vanilla-like clouds, 1 = fully realistic billowing clouds.
Cloud ray marching steps. Lower is faster, higher is smoother.
